newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest sees strong demand in second half.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest sees strong demand in second half.

text.p: Fieldcrest Cannon Inc on Wednesday said that its second quarter results were helped by lower raw material costs and that it sees strong demand for its products in the second half of the year.
Earlier, the company said net income rose to $0.62 a share from $0.11 a share in the second quarter of 1996.
Net income for the 1997 quarter included a pretax gain of $1.5 million, or $0.10 a share, related to the sale of real estate no longer used by the company.

Operating income for the second quarter increased to $15.7 million from $11.0 million a year ago. The increase reflects lower raw material costs, the benefits of recently completed capital projects and continued emphasis on cost reduction programs.
"Demand for our products looks strong for the second half of 1997," said James Fitzgibbons, chairman and chief executive of the company, in a written statement.

"The company is optimistic that benefits from lower raw material costs, recently completed capital projects, and continued emphasis on cost-reduction programs should result in higher operating results for the remainder of the year," he added.
